hero.title: NihongoTracker Desktop Companion
hero.subtitle: A free desktop app that detects what you watch, read, and play, then logs it to NihongoTracker for you. It includes a built-in texthooker, an offline dictionary, and Anki mining.
hero.platforms: Available for Windows, macOS, and Linux

beta.notice: The companion is in beta, so you may find bugs or missing features.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.allReleases: All releases and release notes on GitHub

requirements.macos: macOS 10.15 or later. Apple silicon and Intel.

anime.title: Automatic anime tracking
anime.description: Recognizes mpv, MPC-HC, VLC, PotPlayer, and more. It logs each episode when you reach the viewing threshold, and paused videos do not count.

novels.title: Visual novels and texthooker
novels.description: Link a game executable to a title. The texthooker opens with it, and time counts only while the window is focused.

games.title: Games
games.description: Track play time for linked games. Each session goes to Pending for review when the game closes.

mining.title: Dictionary and mining
mining.description: Import Yomitan dictionaries for offline lookups, save sentences from any window, and send cards to Anki.

offline.title: Offline first
offline.description: Every log goes through a local queue with retries, so a closed app or a lost connection never loses data.

community.title: Friends and ranking
community.description: See friend activity, who is immersing right now, and the leaderboard without opening the website.

install.title: Install the app
install.description: Run the installer for your system. The app updates itself from GitHub and asks before it installs anything.

apiKey.title: Connect your account
apiKey.description: Create an API key in your settings and paste it into the companion when it asks for one.

immerse.title: Start immersing
immerse.description: Open a video, novel, or game. The companion detects it and logs your time automatically.
